info.description: Snapshot of the account-service OpenAPI document. The service's OpenApiExportTest fails when its export differs from this file.
info.title: account-service

200.description: The account, its customer and card; or the account alone with NO_CARD_LINKED (information) when it has no card (D-61).

400.description: ACCT_ID_REQUIRED, INVALID_ACCT_ID, INVALID_IF_MATCH, FIELD_NOT_EDITABLE, NO_CHANGE, or a field rule (with invalidFields).

409.description: RECORD_CHANGED (with current and a fresh ETag), ACCOUNT_LOCK_FAILED or CUSTOMER_LOCK_FAILED.

500.description: ACCOUNT_LOOKUP_FAILED, XREF_LOOKUP_FAILED, CUSTOMER_LOOKUP_FAILED, ACCOUNT_LOCK_FAILED, CUSTOMER_LOCK_FAILED or ACCOUNT_UPDATE_FAILED.

200.description: The requested fields in clear; one ops.audit row written.

400.description: ACCT_ID_REQUIRED, INVALID_ACCT_ID or INVALID_UNMASK_FIELD (ssn, dob, govtIssuedId, eftAccountId, cardNum).
ACCT_ID_REQUIRED, INVALID_ACCT_ID, INVALID_IF_MATCH, FIELD_NOT_EDITABLE, NO_CHANGE, or a field rule (with invalidFields).

409.description: RECORD_CHANGED, with current and a fresh ETag.

400.description: NO_INPUT, ACCT_ID_REQUIRED, INVALID_ACCT_ID, CARD_NUM_REQUIRED or INVALID_CARD_NUM.

404.description: CARD_NOT_FOUND (also for a card of another account, D-13).

200.description: One page, with a notice (information) at the end of the list.

400.description: NO_INPUT, ACCT_ID_REQUIRED, INVALID_ACCT_ID, CARD_NUM_REQUIRED or INVALID_CARD_NUM.

200.description: The card of a list row.

400.description: INVALID_IF_MATCH, NO_CHANGE, or a field rule (with invalidFields).

409.description: RECORD_CHANGED (with current and a fresh ETag) or CARD_LOCK_FAILED.

200.description: The card number in clear; one ops.audit row written.

400.description: INVALID_IF_MATCH, NO_CHANGE, or a field rule (with invalidFields).

409.description: RECORD_CHANGED, with current and a fresh ETag.

current.description: On RECORD_CHANGED: the stored values now, with the fresh ETag.

cardId.description: The card whose cross-reference row named the customer.

dob.description: Masked; write-only through dobYear, dobMonth, dobDay.

ssn.description: Masked; write-only through ssn1, ssn2, ssn3.

version.description: Same value as the ETag, without quotes.

changedFields.description: Changed fields in screen order, one entry per group (its first part).

creditLimitDisplay.description: Legacy edit +ZZZ,ZZZ,ZZZ.99, widened at a billion or more (NUM-ACVW-001).

current.description: On RECORD_CHANGED: the stored values now, with the fresh ETag.

start.description: A firstKey of an earlier CardPage: refresh from that row.

version.description: Same value as the ETag, without quotes.

cardId.description: core.card.card_id; null when the card row is missing.

cardNum.description: Masked to the last four digits (D-09).

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details with the CardDemo fields. message is the exact catalogue text.

fields.description: Field name to clear value, or null.

invalidFields.description: On a field-rule failure: every field that failed, in screen order.
